title: baseline
description: A baseline version (RFC-027): data/baselines/<goal_id>/<dataset_id>/<n>.json, or _dataset/<dataset_id>/<n>.json for a run with no goal. Written once: a promotion or a rollback writes the next version.

actor.description: Who acted (RFC-027): a person, or an agent and the person it acted for. A recorded claim, not an identity.

for.description: the person an agent acted for

reason.description: Why this run earned promotion. Required by the runbook, not by the schema.

goal.description: The goal it is the baseline of; null for the dataset's own (a run with no goal).

format.description: The output format the run was asked for, carried from the run (validate V14).

reference_tier.description: The tier of references the run was scored against, carried from it (validate V6).

adapter.description: The adapter that scored the run, as the run records it (validate V6).

fingerprint_hash.description: The run's fingerprint hash: what the number depended on (validate V6).

repeats.description: When the promoted run is one of an arm's repeats (--repeat): every repeat's run id and the mean of each score over them, the number the catalog, the inspector and the tests read.

version.description: Its number in the line: the file's name.

replaces.description: The version current when it was written (none for the first).

restores.description: A rollback: the earlier version whose run it restores.

migrated.description: Promoted before 0.8.0: its evidence was not recorded.

faithfulness.description: A replay's faithfulness when it was promoted (RFC-030): the record, whether it agreed with production, and who promoted it anyway with --unfaithful.

evidence.description: The comparison that justified it, frozen at promotion: pair-test's answer for its arm against the version it replaced (RFC-027 D3). Null when migrated.

look.description: A look at a test set (RFC-029): its question's key, its number and one-sided level, the set's items digest, the harness version; on a promotion, its verdict and p.
